parameter.name: Not Within Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure

extension.valueString: Most Recent Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure

define "Sleep Study Procedure Present":
  exists ("Sleep Study Procedures")

define "Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure":
  if not "Most Recent Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure" is null
    then "Most Recent Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure"
  else 
    PCF.CaseFeatureObservation(
      AC."Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Assertion",
      PS."Sleep Study Procedure Present",
      'http://example.org/sdh/dtr/aslp/StructureDefinition/aslp-paa-sleepstudy-procedure-casefeature-definition',
      PCF.MostRecent(PS."Sleep Study Procedures"),
      ''
    )
Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Value

define "Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Value":
  "Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure".value.value as System.Boolean

define "Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure":
  IsTrue("Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Value")
Not Within Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure

define "Not Within Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure":
  IsFalse("Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Value")

define "Sleep Study Procedure Unknown":
  IsNull("Is Qualifying Sleep Study Procedure Value")

define "Most Recent Qualifying Other Procedure":
  PCF.MostRecent([Observation: FHIRHelpers.ToCode(singleton from AC."Qualifying Other Procedure Assertion".coding)])

define "Qualifying Other Procedure":
  if not "Most Recent Qualifying Other Procedure" is null
    then "Most Recent Qualifying Other Procedure"
  else 
    PCF.CaseFeatureObservation(
      AC."Qualifying Other Procedure Assertion",
      PS."Other Procedure Present",
      'http://example.org/sdh/dtr/aslp/StructureDefinition/aslp-paa-other-procedure-casefeature-definition',
      PCF.MostRecent(PS."Other Procedures"),
      ''
    )

define "Is Qualifying Other Procedure Value":
  "Qualifying Other Procedure".value.value as System.Boolean

define "Other Procedure Unknown":
  IsNull("Is Qualifying Other Procedure Value")

define "Is Qualifying Other Procedure":
  IsTrue("Is Qualifying Other Procedure Value")

define "Not Within Qualifying Other Procedure":
  IsFalse("Is Qualifying Other Procedure Value")

//TODO: POC only (need to consider all the Observation considerations)
define function MostRecent(value List<FHIR.Observation>):
  First(
    value Observation
      sort by effective descending
  )

define function CaseFeatureObservation( code FHIR.CodeableConcept, value System.Boolean, profile System.String, evidences Choice<FHIR.Procedure,FHIR.Observation,FHIR.Organization,FHIR.Coverage,FHIR.Condition,FHIR.Patient,FHIR.DeviceRequest>, evidenceText System.String):
  if evidences is null then
    CaseFeatureObservation(code, value, Now(), profile, null as List<FHIR.Observation>, evidenceText)
  else 
    CaseFeatureObservation(code, value, Now(), profile, {evidences}, evidenceText)

//TODO: flesh out other types of resources
define fluent function typeof(resource Choice<FHIR.Procedure,FHIR.Observation,FHIR.Organization,FHIR.Coverage,FHIR.Condition,FHIR.Patient,FHIR.DeviceRequest>): 
  case
    when resource is null then
      // Message(null, true, 'FHIRCommon.typeof.UnknownFHIResource', 'Error', 'Unknown resource type: resource is null')
      'Resource type not found: resource is null'
    when resource is Patient then
      'Patient'
    when resource is Condition then  
      'Condition'
    when resource is Observation then  
      'Observation'
    when resource is Procedure then  
      'Procedure'
    when resource is Coverage then  
      'Coverage'
    when resource is Encounter then  
      'Encounter'
    when resource is Organization then  
      'Organization'
    when resource is DeviceRequest then  
      'DeviceRequest'
    else
      // Message(null, true, 'FHIRCommon.typeof.UnknownFHIResource', 'Error', 'Unknown resource type: ' + resource.id)
      'Resource type not found for:' + resource.id 
  end
